title: Durable Review Queue
intent: Persist open and completed reviews with restart-safe ordering and integrity checks.
problem: Without transactional queue persists open review, decision and receipt records, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the durable review queue contract.
context: This pattern addresses human review spans processes or restarts; its concrete control is transactional queue persists open review, decision and receipt records.
forces: Correctness requires that restart preserves every unresolved review
Operational pressure can cause: crash commits state without its receipt
solution: Implement transactional queue persists open review, decision and receipt records. Verify the anchored symbol `DurableStoreError` with `test_review_detail_is_principal_scoped` before reuse.
invariants: one review decision produces one durable receipt
failure_modes: crash commits state without its receipt
duplicate delivery creates two open reviews
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `crash commits state without its receipt` and fails closed if the durable review queue evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For durable review queue, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to transactional queue persists open review, decision and receipt records.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: human review spans processes or restarts
Do not apply when: review finishes synchronously inside one failure-free call
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: human review spans processes or restarts
not_when: review finishes synchronously inside one failure-free call
